messages:
alex: Hey finance — I booked a yellow cab home last night after the offsite and got a surprise surge of $48.60 on a $32.00 fare. I paid with my personal card and uploaded the receipt to Ramp: https://ramp.app/receipts/abc123 (image attached). Filing as 'Taxi - personal card'.

jordan: can you paste the photo here or @maria? Need the timestamp and pickup/dropoff to confirm policy exception.

alex: sure — pic shows 2026-03-22 23:18, JFK -> Brooklyn, driver printed a "peak surcharge" line of $16.60. Full line item: Fare $32.00, Peak surcharge $16.60, Tip $0 (I didn't tip), Total $48.60.

maria: Thanks. Per expense policy: standard taxi reimbursements are allowed up to $40 without manager approval; overages due to unavoidable safety concerns (late night trains cancelled, etc.) can be approved by the manager. Was there a transit disruption?

alex: yes — trains were delayed 45m per MTA alerts, we were the last group leaving the venue. Shared receipts from a few folks in the offsite thread — most took rides at the same time.

jordan: pinging @maria — can you confirm manager approval? If manager signs off we can process reimbursement for the extra $8.60. Otherwise we can reimburse up to $40 and mark the surcharge as denied.

maria: I approve the excess $8.60 given the transit delay and late hour. Approving here for audit trail. :white_check_mark: Alex — please change expense to show manager approval and re-submit in Ramp with the MTA delay screenshot attached.

alex: done — re-submitted with MTA screenshot and added manager comment: "Approved by Maria (sr director) due to 45m transit delay 3/22". Thanks.

finance-bot: Reminder: per audit rules attach a screenshot of the transit alert or a short note from the event organizer confirming the delay. Once Ramp shows manager approval the payment will go through on the next run.

jordan: finance will pick this up in the next batch. Alex expect reimbursement in 5-7 business days after processing.

alex: appreciated, thanks everyone :pray:
